category: premium-account reseller (Indian: INR pricing across several debrid services)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'Debrid-Link Premium 1 Month - Original price was: ₹1,000.00. Current price is: ₹750.00.' The site also lists LinkSnappy Elite 180 days at ₹9,900 against ₹11,000 list.
free_tier.notes: Prices are the reseller's, not the provider's; the rupee figures include the Indian reseller margin.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; the debrid service's own cap applies

retention.stated: not applicable: a 30-day entitlement, not storage

egress.terms: Debrid-Link's own terms; the reseller restates features, not limits: 'Seedbox Downloading / Seeding', 'Streaming HTML5', 'High speed download', 'All addons available'.

interface_detail: WooCommerce store; the buyer receives a Debrid-Link entitlement and uses Debrid-Link's own web app and API.
tooling: The underlying service's API is what matters after purchase (Debrid-Link has a documented API and web app); the store itself adds nothing.
chaining: The Indian on-ramp to a European debrid: it turns a rupee payment into a Debrid-Link month. Chains with JDownloader/rclone exactly as Debrid-Link does, because it is Debrid-Link.

limits.value: manual store checkout; entitlement delivered after payment

limits_note: The store publishes no limit of its own; the 30-day term is the only quantity it states.
binding_note: The reseller adds no constraint; Debrid-Link's per-day host quotas become the binding ones after activation.

identity_cost.detail: The product page publishes no payment-method list, and the checkout was not entered. The store describes itself as 'official distributor and reseller of various software licenses in India', so a card or an Indian wallet is the minimum such a checkout implies; it is not confirmed.

reliability_note: A reseller margin with no published refund terms on the product page; the entitlement depends on a third party (Debrid-Link) staying up, and the store carries no responsibility for that.
confidence_note: Price and feature list read from the product page. The payment rail is unconfirmed and flagged as such; entering checkout with an Indian address would settle it.

evidence.proved: 'Original price was: ₹1,000.00. Current price is: ₹750.00.'; '30 days Debrid-Link Premium Access'; '247premiumcart.com is official distributor and reseller of various software licenses in India'
second price point from the same store: LinkSnappy Elite 180 days 'Original price was: ₹11,000.00. Current price is: ₹9,900.00'

price_per_tb_month: INR 750 per 30 days for Debrid-Link (list INR 1,000)
notes: India buys global debrid through rupee resellers because the providers bill in EUR/USD and many Indian buyers have no international card. That is the same gate as Indonesia's, answered with a reseller instead of a local service.
